newsitem.title: USA: US Justice Department to review Hughes acquisition.
newsitem.headline: US Justice Department to review Hughes acquisition.

text.p: The Justice Department will look at the proposed $9.5 billion acquisition of the Hughes Aircraft defense unit by Raytheon, a Justice Department spokesman said Tuesday.

General Motors agreed to sell the Hughes defense unit to Raytheon on January 16. That would likely create the third-largest U.S. military contractor, trailing only the company that Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas will form after a merger and Lockheed Martin Corp.

Until now, the Federal Trade Commission has reviewed most mergers involving defense contractors. But a Justice spokesman said its staff took the case because of extensive knowledge about the missile industry. Hughes specializes in missiles and radar.
The Justice Department is being advised by the Pentagon, which has a special unit that reviews defense industry mergers. However, final decisions will be made by the Justice Department in the matter.
